name: history-week-based-to-week-based-week-pattern-transition
description: A week-based calendar that changes from years ending on the Saturday nearest 31 January (the NRF rule, weeks from Sunday) to years ending on the Saturday nearest 31 December, through a 47-week transition from 2024-02-04 to 2024-12-28 with a week_pattern of 11 periods (4-4-5 repeated, then 4-4) in quarters of 3, 3, 3 and 2 periods. Numbered by 'majority': 2023, 2024 (the transition), 2025. Covers week Periods with weeks 1 and has_extra_week false in the transition, weeks nested in transition periods and quarters, and shift from the 53rd week of 2023 into the transition and out of it. Illustrative.

source.citation: Independent implementation of the spec in conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py, written with Python datetime and no fiscalclock code
